key_catalyst: Pre-earnings AI capex anxiety ahead of Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, and Meta reports this week, compounded by Wednesday's FOMC decision with ~30% odds of a surprise rate hike
reasoning: QQQ has now fallen for four consecutive sessions (07-22 through 07-27, cumulative ~4.9%) with no sign of catalyst absorption. The AI capex scare that began with Alphabet and Tesla on 07-23 is escalating, not resolving, as Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, and Meta all report this week—amplifying the risk of further de-rating in QQQ's largest constituents. Layered on top are a Wednesday FOMC meeting with a non-trivial 30% odds of a hawkish surprise, sticky oil-driven inflation repricing, and Section 301 tariffs that just took effect on 07-24, creating a convergence of unresolved, forward-looking risks into the overnight and next session.
